close_reason: Config keys documented in config.example.toml for smtp, mail, reader: min_tls_version=TLS1.2 (default, enforced in code), cipher_suites=approved list. Policy is enforced at code level, not runtime-selectable.
description:
## Why
Operators need documented config knobs to verify TLS policy. PCI-DSS compliance requires these be explicit.

## What
- Add optional min_tls_version and cipher_suites fields to TlsConfig in smtp, mail, and reader crates
- Document regulatory defaults in config.example.toml / inline doc comments
- Wire the fields into the ServerConfig builder

## Acceptance
- TlsConfig has min_tls_version (default: tls12) and cipher_suites (default: approved list)
- Config files document the regulatory default
title: TLS config keys: min_tls_version and cipher_suites
